artifact.name: agent_rigel_data_panel_v1
artifact.title: Six-gene panel for mechanistic follow-up, with the reason each gene is on it
artifact.description:
The output of the panel selection: six genes, each with its stage assignment, its rank in each screen, and the caveat a reader would otherwise have to reconstruct from three Artifacts.

The third selection rule preferred direct effectors and would have removed ELF1, CLEC4D and REC8, all three of which induce ISG54 on overexpression and are therefore expected to act indirectly. They were kept. Removing them would have left entry represented by two genes and would have discarded the strongest validation result in the study, and the comparison between direct and indirect restriction at entry is part of what this panel is for. The consequence is that half the panel needs a different first experiment, which the `caveat` column says gene by gene.

Five of the six are placed at entry and one at assembly and egress, which reflects what the source reported rather than where restriction concentrates.

objects.name: csv
objects.description: The six selected genes held in the `values` property. The two rank columns are ranks over all 37 cross-validated genes, not over the six shown, and they are products of the ranking Model's rules rather than measurements. The validation normalized infection value in each row is a measurement and may be cited as one.
